forWhat: Move each assessment from made to results, and see what is stuck.
The board has four lanes: To approve and print, With the children, To read and check, and Results in. Each card is one assessment, with its one next button.
Choose a card and the assessment opens on the right: each child's copy, uploading its papers, the answers to check, and its results.

layout.shows: [[Make an assessment]] opens four choices: [[For a class]], [[For each child]], [[For one child]] and [[A ready-made worksheet]].
Class, Subject and Week, with Topic, Kind and Stage under More filters, and a search box.
[[Board]], [[Table]], [[By topic]] and [[Reading]]. Reading lists the files read lately and what each one lacks.
Four lanes of cards. A card shows the topic and class, the date and how many papers are back, one status, and the next button.
With no card chosen: papers waiting to check, answers to judge, and papers with checks overdue. With a card chosen: the tabs Copies, Upload, Check and Results, and [[Open full page]].

jobs.title: Make an assessment for a class
steps: Press the tile [[For a class]].
Choose the class, what it is, how it is made, and the children.
Press [[See the papers]]. Every child's paper shows on screen before anything is made.
Not happy with a child's questions? Press [[Different questions]]. It draws others and makes nothing.
Press [[Make … papers]]. The papers are made exactly as you saw them, in your name.
The assessment opens. Approve the pack there before it prints.

jobs.title: Approve and print the pack
steps: Open the assessment, from its name or its row's [[Approve]] button.
Read each child's copy and level. Nothing prints without your approval.
Press [[Approve the pack]]. It approves this pack only.
Press [[Print]]. It shows only once the pack is approved.

jobs.title: Change one child's level before print
steps: Open the assessment before its pack is approved.
On the child's row, choose the new level and write why. A change with no reason is refused.
Press [[Change this child]]. The engine leaves that child's level alone next time.

jobs.title: Make a home assessment
steps: Open the child's page. The panel [[Home assessment]] shows the paper the engine proposes, from the child's own answers.
Press [[See it as it will print]] to look at it. Press [[Different questions]] for others; it makes nothing.
To choose the skills and levels yourself, press [[Choose a different home assessment]].
Press [[Approve this home assessment]]. It is made and printed in your name.
On a home assessment's own page, [[Edit this paper]] lets you add or remove a question before print.

jobs.title: Upload and read papers
steps: Photograph or scan the papers, in page order.
On the board, choose the assessment's card and open its Upload tab.
Drop the files in [[Choose scans or drop them here]], or paste a Google Drive link and press [[Read it]].
Each PDF is read on its own. Photos chosen together are read as one paper.
Every page is matched to its child by the code printed on it.
When reading is done, open the Check tab for what the engine was not sure of.

jobs.title: A page with no code that can be read
steps: Open the view [[Reading]]. The file's row says which page had no code it could read.
Press the button with the child's name to say whose page it is. The page is then read as theirs.
The engine never guesses whose page it is.

jobs.title: Check and sign off a child's paper
steps: Press the row's [[Check … answers]] button, or [[Check this paper]] on a child's row.
The child's page shows as photographed, with each answer as the engine read it.
If the engine read it right, press [[Yes, the child wrote …]].
If not, type what the child wrote and press [[Say what the child wrote]]. For an empty box, press [[Blank (the child wrote nothing)]].
For an answer only a person can mark, press [[Right]], [[Wrong]] or [[Blank]].
Press [[Next answer to judge]]. When nothing is left, press [[Sign this paper off]].

jobs.title: Follow an assessment
steps: Find its card on the board. The filter row and search help when the board is long.
Press the card's next button: [[Approve]], [[Print]], [[Upload]], [[Check … answers]], [[Sign off … papers]] or [[See results]].
Press the card itself to see the assessment on the right, or [[Open full page]] for its own page.

jobs.title: See how a child is doing
steps: On an assessment with results in, press [[The child]] on the child's row. Their page opens.
[[What their answers show]] is a row per topic: the level of their newest question, their last paper's answers, their state, and their strongest or weakest skill.
On a paper, press [[See the child’s page]] to see what the child wrote.
[[Repeated mistakes]] shows a mistake they make more than once. [[Report card]] and [[Parent report]] open their reports.

jobs.title: Rename an assessment
steps: Type the new name in the field under its name and press [[Save the name]].
The old names are kept. An empty name changes nothing.

buttons.label: See the papers
buttons.does: Shows every child's paper before anything is made.

buttons.label: Different questions
buttons.does: Draws other questions for you to look at.

buttons.label: Make … papers
buttons.does: Makes the papers you saw, in your name.
buttons.doesNot: If you change a choice, it waits until you see the papers again. Nothing prints until the pack is approved.

buttons.label: Approve the pack
buttons.does: Approves this pack's papers and spares in your name.

buttons.label: Change this child
buttons.does: Sets that child's level and records who changed it and why.

buttons.label: Say what the child wrote
buttons.does: Records what the child wrote. The engine then marks it by the answer key.
buttons.doesNot: The engine's own reading is kept beside yours, never written over.

buttons.label: Sign this paper off
buttons.does: Signs off the paper's answers in your name. Only signed off answers count.
buttons.doesNot: A signed off answer is never edited afterwards. A correction is added as a new one.

buttons.label: Read it
buttons.does: Reads the scan at a Google Drive link.
buttons.doesNot: It takes only Google Drive links.

buttons.label: Save the name
buttons.does: Gives the assessment a new name.
buttons.doesNot: The older names are kept, not deleted.

buttons.label: Read again
buttons.doesNot: Answers a person has checked stay as they were left.
